WITH window_reviews AS (
  SELECT r.review_id, p.product_id
  FROM reviews.order_reviews AS r
  JOIN orders.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
  JOIN orders.products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name = 'relogios_presentes'
    AND r.review_creation_date IS NOT NULL
    AND r.review_creation_date >= DATE '2018-01-01'
    AND r.review_creation_date < DATE '2018-02-01'
),
window_counts AS (
  SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM window_reviews
  GROUP BY product_id
),
window_total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
  FROM window_reviews
),
window_share AS (
  SELECT MAX(cnt)::DOUBLE / ANY_VALUE(total_cnt) AS top_share,
         COUNT(*) AS n_products,
         ANY_VALUE(total_cnt) AS total_reviews
  FROM window_counts, window_total
),
baseline_reviews AS (
  SELECT r.review_id, p.product_id
  FROM reviews.order_reviews AS r
  JOIN orders.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
  JOIN orders.products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name = 'relogios_presentes'
    AND r.review_creation_date IS NOT NULL
    AND r.review_creation_date >= DATE '2017-12-01'
    AND r.review_creation_date < DATE '2018-01-01'
),
baseline_counts AS (
  SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM baseline_reviews
  GROUP BY product_id
),
baseline_total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
  FROM baseline_reviews
),
baseline_share AS (
  SELECT MAX(cnt)::DOUBLE / ANY_VALUE(total_cnt) AS top_share,
         COUNT(*) AS n_products,
         ANY_VALUE(total_cnt) AS total_reviews
  FROM baseline_counts, baseline_total
)
SELECT ROUND(w.top_share, 4) AS value,
       ROUND(b.top_share, 4) AS baseline,
       w.total_reviews AS window_total_reviews,
       b.total_reviews AS baseline_total_reviews,
       w.n_products AS window_n_products,
       b.n_products AS baseline_n_products
FROM window_share w, baseline_share b;
